cohort: 229 cases of placental abruption from Tianjin Central Hospital of Gynecology and Obstetrics between January 2016 and December 2017
finding: Placental abruption complicated with preeclampsia and/or intrauterine growth restriction was associated with poorer neonatal outcomes, but there was no significant difference in maternal prognosis.
mod_finding: In preterm abruption, the IPD group had a significantly higher cesarean section rate than the non-IPD group.
birth_weight: Significantly lower in the IPD group
